name: free-llm
title: Free LLM
description: A backup brain. Connect a free model provider (Groq or Cloudflare Workers AI) and Nyo keeps working when the main model has no key or no credit. Ships its own gateway, its own key store, and its own page.

gateways.purpose: reach the free provider over its OpenAI-compatible endpoint

tables.name: plugin_free_llm_config
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_free_llm_config (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, provider TEXT NOT NULL, api_key TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT, account_id TEXT, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

def.name: connect_free_llm
def.description: Connect a FREE model provider as this install's backup brain. provider is 'groq' (get a key at console.groq.com/keys, no card) or 'cloudflare' (Workers AI, needs account_id + an API token). The key is stored in this plugin's own table and verified with one real request before it is reported working.

model.description: optional; each provider has a sensible default

def.name: disconnect_free_llm
def.description: Forget the connected free model provider and its key. Nyo goes back to the main model only.

def.name: free_llm_status
def.description: What free backup model this install has connected, if any. Pass check:true to spend one tiny request confirming it still answers.

check.description: also make one real request to confirm it answers
